label: Economics API demonstration
description: Synthetic one-person fixture for UI integration; not an Ankura forecast.

parameters.label: Delivery-hour reduction
parameters.description: Fraction of delivery hours saved on each unit of work.

parameters.label: Fixed-fee pricing
parameters.description: 0 bills actual hours; 1 bills baseline contracted work.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.definition: Cumulative revenue difference over the selected interval.

metrics.label: Cost
metrics.definition: Cumulative cost difference over the selected interval.

metrics.label: Profit
metrics.definition: Cumulative profit difference over the selected interval.

metrics.label: Hours
metrics.definition: Cumulative hours difference over the selected interval.

metrics.label: Capacity
metrics.definition: Cumulative capacity difference over the selected interval.

metrics.label: Operating contribution margin
metrics.definition: Selected operating contribution divided by selected revenue; excludes tax and financing.

metrics.label: Utilization
metrics.definition: Actual delivery hours divided by paid capacity hours over the selected interval.
